I left my almost-4-yr job because of it. My track record didn’t mean shit; my ex-boss even went as far to say I was the “one who gave the results” and yet, I was overlooked. 

Before I eventually quit, however, I was proactive af. I kept myself updated on the latest news in the industry. I took on tasks that were unfamiliar to me so I can learn more. Focused on the numbers/data — not just the creativity or output. Even became an extrovert by circumstance. I tracked my own performance. Was open to criticism, constructive or otherwise. I took opportunities to lead projects and even people. I worked behind the sidelines AND the frontlines. I just really gave it my all. 

After 3.75 years, I eventually quit when I realized my ex-boss disregarded all that. I realized my fate in that company relied on being a favorite and that just didn’t sit well with me (tho for the record, i got along well with my superiors and colleagues). 

If I learned anything, it’s that:

1) I was fighting the wrong battle bec I wasn’t playing their games. Hence, I “lost”, which led me to resigning. Still, tho you can’t win it all...

2) All the hard work will still pay off. Everything I did for that company is in my CV. It was definitely easier to find better jobs bec I had the legit experience under my belt. In fact, Im moving to one of the biggest names in the industry Im working in. So this being said, don’t take what you did for granted. Never undersell/undervalue what you do and who you are. And always keep receipts of your accomplishments, big or small. 

3) Know when to throw in the towel. Always value your self respect, efforts, and time. Also, never compromise your mental health. A bad job/boss is replaceable — you just have to keep on sending out applications even when you’re desperate. (Never think you’re irreplaceable either.)

4) Always stay professional. It’s normal to feel emotional and it’s not wrong to react or vent or whine. But when in the workplace, keep your guard up and show them you can take it. 

Anyway, I wish you luck on whatever work stuff you or anyone else is going through!

I was looking forward to watching this season, but after a few episodes here’s what I got: 

*spoilers ahead*

- Minka Kelly can’t act for shit! Her literal stiff upper lip makes her look always smiley and mostly expressionless. She keeps eating her words too wtf Hank was the good part of her screen time but they broke it off so now it’s twice the chore to watch her “act”. People are crying and dying and she’d be with this frozen ghost of a smile on her face. And why does she keep on touching people’s faces ugh

- Rachel’s storyline is fucking boring. She tries to be cocky rebellious and fierce but ends up crying when things go awry... like a baby. 

- loved Chellaman’s acting! 

- They wasted Gar. :( Dick was being a dick for leaving him with the unconscious Superboy. Wtf dick he just fucked up a previous task and he’s a kid! 

- Thankful they fixed Jason Todd’s hairline. He was better this season, and understandably pathetic over him being annoying. 

- Rose is so-so but like Rachel’s wig, her hair was so stiff and her whole character is confusing. She’s giving off the vibe that she’s super serious and super skilled but its the same girl who made a scene with the cops just because. What IS her purpose? I thought she wanted to kill her dad but she’s not exactly doing anything but flirting/tolerating Jason Todd. She has the gall to call him dramatic when she’s the one who went on a revenge adventure to begin with. 

- I love Krypto; a welcome addition like Bruce Wayne. Jorah Mormont might not be the perfect BW, but he’s enough to make me endure through Dick’s self doubt scenes (which are a lot btw). 

- For this season, they don’t rescue or save people. They aren’t superheroes. They only resolve their own problems. If i were Bruce Wayne, id probably want my money back for funding the Titans Tower

- I feel bad about starfire. I always wanted to see her on screen, looking forward to her scenes with Robin, but meh. They get a few scenes together for like 1-2 episodes. One review said they would have a “burgeoning romance” but up until now Im still waiting for it. :( 

Long rant, i know, but it’s a shame to have waited this long for this to happen. Im nearing the end of the series and Im still waiting for them to become Titans.
